clue.text: Note sum charged in unauthorised occupation of quantity of floor space

indicators.note: the note and the sum are placed in the middle of the word for the occupation

parts.note: a squat is a building occupied without permission
re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
a fee is a sum charged for a service

explanation.surface: A squatter is billed for the space they took over without permission.
explanation.definitionFit: Floor area is measured in units of this size, so the phrase names an amount of floor space.

clue.text: Window frame made by son, with wood

parts.note: ash is a timber from the ash tree

explanation.surface: A carpenter's son builds a window frame from timber.
explanation.definitionFit: The sliding glazed panel of a vertically opening window is known by this name.

clue.text: Able to take a stretch briefly after university, one's employed in the kitchen

indicators.note: the shortened word is placed following the abbreviation for university
briefly asks for the word to be cut short by its final letter

parts.note: tensile describes something capable of being stretched

explanation.surface: A graduate able to stretch themselves finds work in a kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen tool or implement is employed in cooking, the sense of 'one's employed' here.

clue.text: Bloomer after posh car company gives scary ride

indicators.note: the flower comes following the car and the company

parts.note: Roller is slang for a Rolls-Royce, a luxury car
a bloomer here is something that blooms, a flower such as the aster

explanation.surface: A blunder by a luxury carmaker produces a frightening ride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' looks like a blunder or a loaf, but here it means a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: A fairground switchback ride with steep drops is designed to thrill and frighten.

clue.text: Oppose rugby forwards getting cosmetic treatment

parts.note: to face an opponent is to oppose them
in rugby the forwards are collectively called the pack

explanation.surface: Front-row rugby players opposing each other end up needing beauty care.
explanation.definitionFit: A cream or clay mask spread over the skin is a beauty treatment for the face.

clue.text: Make electrics safe in underground shelter

definitions.meaning: to connect a circuit to the ground for safety
a fox's or badger's burrow is called by this name

explanation.surface: An electrician makes the wiring safe in a bunker.
explanation.definitionFit: Grounding a circuit and an animal's burrow are both meanings of the one word.

clue.text: Fraud from flipping computers

indicators.note: flipping turns the word for the computers back to front

parts.note: Macs are Apple Macintosh computers

explanation.surface: A con involving computers being resold.
explanation.definitionFit: A swindle or confidence trick is a deception, a synonym for fraud.

clue.text: Caught old tennis star pocketing one keyboard

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: pocketing means the tennis player's name takes the numeral inside it

parts.note: Rod Laver was the great Australian tennis champion of the 1960s
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A retired tennis champion is caught taking a piano.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an old name for a keyboard instrument such as a harpsichord or clavichord.

clue.text: Island bananas to be put on old Turkish officer's vehicle

indicators.note: in a down entry the first piece sits on top of the rest

parts.note: bananas is slang for crazy, mad
an aga was an Ottoman military commander; the possessive gives the S
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Fruit is loaded onto an Ottoman officer's car.
explanation.definitionFit: This large island lies off the south-east coast of Africa.

clue.text: Dandy to get fat

definitions.meaning: to grow larger or puff up

explanation.surface: A fop who is putting on weight.
explanation.definitionFit: A dated word for a fashionable toff, and also a verb for expanding or bulging.

clue.text: Eccentric directors of stiff material

parts.note: a card is an eccentric or amusing person
a company's directors form its board

explanation.surface: Odd company directors made of rigid stuff.
explanation.definitionFit: Thick pasteboard is a rigid paper material used for boxes.

clue.text: Original ideas from hit issue

parts.note: to brain someone is to hit them on the head
issue means offspring

explanation.surface: Fresh concepts come out of a successful publication.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hit issue' reads like a best-selling edition, but hit is a verb and issue means offspring.
explanation.definitionFit: Inventions or schemes conceived by a person are figuratively their offspring.

clue.text: The woman records trial wherein some get fleeced

parts.note: she refers to a woman
EPs are extended-play records
a court hearing is a trial

explanation.surface: A woman's recordings of a court case in which people are swindled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fleeced' suggests being cheated, but here the woolly creatures literally lose their fleeces.
explanation.definitionFit: The annual clipping of wool from the flock is an event in which animals are fleeced.

clue.text: Arranges a best focus? Not at all!

definitions.text: Arranges a best focus? Not at all!

indicators.note: arranges tells us to reorder the letters of the following words

explanation.surface: Someone sets up the sharpest focus, or rather does the very opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines: rearranging a best focus is far from clarifying, which is what the answer does.
explanation.definitionFit: To muddy or make unclear is the reverse of bringing something into sharp focus.

clue.text: In support, learner left with care of plumbing item

indicators.note: In at the start places the following pieces within the word for support

parts.note: to back someone is to support them
L is for learner, as on L-plates
c/o is the postal abbreviation for care of

explanation.surface: A trainee left in someone's care is backed up.
explanation.definitionFit: A float-operated valve that controls the water filling a cistern or tank.

clue.text: Artist has entry cut short

indicators.note: cut short means the last letter of the word for entry is dropped

parts.note: ingress is the act of entering

explanation.surface: A painter's entrance is abbreviated.
explanation.definitionFit: Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres was a French Neoclassical painter.

clue.text: More masculine, given second look

parts.note: butch means masculine, so the comparative is more masculine

explanation.surface: A more macho person gets a second glance.
explanation.walkthrough: Butcher's hook is Cockney rhyming slang for a look, shortened to butcher's.
explanation.definitionFit: In British rhyming slang 'have a butcher's' means take a glance.

clue.text: Austen novel to get from office

indicators.note: novel as an adjective means new, so the author's name is made new by reordering

explanation.surface: A Jane Austen book to be picked up from the office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Austen novel' looks like a book title, but novel signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: To depose or remove someone from a post or seat of power.

clue.text: One has a row in kitchen mostly

indicators.note: mostly means all but the last letter of the word for kitchen

parts.note: a scullery is a back kitchen for washing dishes

explanation.surface: Someone has an argument in a kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: Row rhymes with 'cow' in the surface but with 'go' in the definition: rowing a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: An oarsman propelling a boat with a pair of oars is someone who has a row.

clue.text: Ecstasy gets a hip roue smashed

indicators.note: smashed means the letters are broken and put back in a new order

explanation.surface: A trendy debauchee gets drunk on the drug.
explanation.walkthrough: A roué is a debauched man; 'Ecstasy' suggests the drug but means bliss.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense happiness or elation is a synonym for ecstasy.

clue.text: Snack, lightly cooked — something boring

parts.note: rare meat is only lightly cooked
a drill bit bores holes

explanation.surface: A lightly cooked snack that turns out dull.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boring' means dull in the surface, but here it means drilling.
explanation.definitionFit: Welsh rarebit, cheese on toast, is a light snack.

clue.text: Where one's tried to get round report of royals

parts.note: a defendant is tried in a court
circular means round

explanation.surface: Someone on trial seeks a way around a royal report.
explanation.definitionFit: The daily published record of the British royal family's engagements.

clue.text: Vacation I arrange includes ancient region of Eastern Mediterranean

indicators.note: includes signals that the answer sits within the run of words before it

explanation.surface: Someone plans a holiday to the eastern Mediterranean.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek coastal region of western Asia Minor on the Aegean.

clue.text: Man perhaps that follows Carl in Northern city

indicators.note: we want the part of the city's name coming after the given name, so that name is removed

parts.note: Carlisle is a city in Cumbria in northern England

explanation.surface: A man named Carl living in a northern city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' looks like a person, but it is the Isle of Man, in the Irish Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The Isle of Man is an example of an island, hence 'perhaps'.

clue.text: An elector undermined liberal position

indicators.note: undermined suggests the words are knocked down and rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: A voter subverted a progressive stance.
explanation.definitionFit: Being open-minded and accepting of others' views is a liberal attitude.

clue.text: Detective on public transport

parts.note: re means on or concerning
a bus is public transport

explanation.surface: A detective travelling by bus.
explanation.definitionFit: Inspector John Rebus is Ian Rankin's Edinburgh police detective.

clue.text: Rejected love that produces pain

indicators.note: rejected means the word is sent back, read from the end

parts.note: Eros is the Greek god of love

explanation.surface: Being spurned in love brings heartache.
explanation.definitionFit: A raw or tender spot that hurts is a painful place, a synonym for pain.

clue.text: Estimate on repairing starter home?

indicators.note: repairing suggests the letters are fixed up into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A builder's quote for fixing up a first-time buyer's house.
explanation.definitionFit: A small flat on two floors is the kind of modest property a first buyer might choose, hence the question mark.
